subject: Minimum amount of data/length of collection period

messages.author: 241c11bbfa1bf799
messages.subject: Minimum amount of data/length of collection period
parts:
Hello,

I am trying to process some short duration AX3 files (.cwa) with GGIR. These files include about 35 minutes of wear time. Unforutnately, I get an error 'No files to analyse.' when I run my GGIR script on the folder that contains the short duration AX3 files (.cwa). When I place some multi-day recording .cwa files in the folder, the GGIR script works without issue.

Is there a minimum duration of recording that works with GGIR? I searched the forum and the package documentation and do not find any indication that there is a minimum duration. If anyone can help, that would be appreciated.

Thanks,
Grant

messages.author: 05de4f382b390d3d
messages.subject: Re: Minimum amount of data/length of collection period
parts:
Hi Grant,

There is no limit in the file duration, but there is a default filter that would skip any file <2MB. You can make this lower with the argument minimumFileSizeMB

Best,
Jairo

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Re: Minimum amount of data/length of collection period
parts:
GGIR needs at least a couple of large window sizes (60 minutes) in the data in order to perform the non-wear detection. In a lab-setting this is not really needed, so what you could do is to set argument windowsizes = c(5, 300, 300).

This should now be able to process files with 10 or more minutes of data.

Vincent
